channels.label: Install script
channels.what: Downloads the latest Halotrcer release from GitHub, verifies it (the cosign signature when cosign is installed, then the SHA-256), installs halotrcer, then has it install Tokvera and Sievant, each verified against its own release. It never uses sudo.

verify.text: The script verifies every release before installing anything. To check the script itself, compare its SHA-256 with the one published on the install page.

channels.label: PowerShell
channels.what: The same steps on Windows; it never asks for administrator rights.

verify.text: The script verifies every release before installing anything. To check the script itself, compare its SHA-256 with the one published on the install page.

channels.label: Homebrew
channels.what: Installs the Halotrcer cask from the rajasatyajit tap.

channels.label: Scoop
channels.what: Adds the rajasatyajit bucket, then installs.

channels.label: winget
channels.what: Installs from the winget community repository.

channels.label: apt
commands: sudo apt update && sudo apt install halotrcer
channels.what: Adds the signed apt repository, so apt installs and updates halotrcer.

verify.text: The repository metadata and every package are signed with the OpenPGP key halotrcer-packages.asc (fingerprint D2D9 6618 831A C55B 81E2 4DA3 039B 5DA0 D3E3 9071).
verify.cite: tokvera docs/install.md "The apt and yum repositories" (shared repository)

channels.label: dnf / yum
channels.what: Adds the signed yum repository for Fedora, RHEL and Amazon Linux.

channels.label: apk
channels.what: Installs the apk signing key once, then a signed package from the release (Alpine).

channels.label: GitHub Releases
